caseName: Unterthiner v. Desert Hospital District of Palm Springs
caseNameFull: Unterthiner v. Desert Hospital District of Palm Springs

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Cal. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until November 21, 1983, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 45(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33 of the Rules of this Court.
